resources.string: Boox Notes’ pen speed, lent to other apps

In Boox Notes the stroke appears under the nib at once, because the display draws it directly instead of waiting for the app. Instant ink switches that same path on while an app you pick is in front: a preview stroke lands the moment the pen touches, and once you pause, the app’s own strokes replace the preview. The app itself is not changed and still receives every pen movement.

Android only tells an app which app is open when you allow usage access. Without it Instant ink waits forever and never switches on. Tap the key, find BooxUltimatum in the list and allow it; no computer is needed.

If preview ink ever stays on screen, Recover screen ends the pen session, undoes the other display changes a session can leave and repaints everything. Clean screen flashes the whole panel once to clear ghosting.
Pen session ended and screen repainted
Show the app’s strokes after a pause of

While you write, the display holds the app’s own drawing back, so quick strokes share one preview, as in Boox Notes, and the app’s screen doesn’t change until you pause. Once the pen has rested this long after a lift, or leaves the screen, the app’s strokes take over in its own brush and colour. A shorter pause shows them sooner; a longer one keeps quick writing on the preview. Boox’s own screen notes wait between 400 ms and 2 s the same way.

The preview is Boox’s own brush in black, not the app’s brush, colour or eraser: those appear when the app’s strokes take over, once you pause or at once when the pen leaves the screen. Pencil is textured and can look broken at small widths, so Fountain pen is the default. While the pen’s eraser end is near, and while the screen is off or locked, the preview pauses; it picks up again as the tip comes near. Instant ink needs one permission you can grant on the tablet, usage access, so it knows which app is in front; it runs as a small foreground service so Android doesn’t freeze it behind the drawing app. Turn off or Recover screen ends it at once.

The Quick Settings switch and the buttons on Instant ink’s notification turn it off or recover the screen without leaving your drawing app. The Clean screen tile flashes the panel as soon as you close Quick Settings.
